detail.note: Exact IDs only; legacy aliases need an explicit reviewed mapping. Candidate existence is not human approval.

detail.freshness: Recorded report coverage checked; rerun validator after edits. Reports are not cryptographically tied to GLBs.

detail.note: Checks current output hashes against baseline plus recorded rebuild; does not execute the rebuild.

checks.detail: No verified human decisions bound to geometry/palette/recipe hashes. Never infer approval from generated candidates or PASS tests.
Some original generators carry provenance; per-canonical-model author/tool/date/reference-purpose/AI-stage completeness and approved input allowlist are not verified.

detail.scope: 84 fresh per-model file/LOD/evidence records; not provenance or human approval.
Four existing LOD1 pairs only; full catalog coverage and LOD2 remain open.

checks.detail: Every canonical model needs LOD policy and documented omission/exception, with preserved sockets/collider. Existence of a few LOD1 files is insufficient.
Headless import/resource tests and matplotlib geometry previews do not establish GPU material, shadows, wind, mipmap, or LOD transition quality.
No verified Android/iOS device measurements for 100/500/1000 objects, warmup 60s, measurement 120s, p50/p95 CPU/GPU, draw calls, memory and load time. Do not claim mobile optimization complete.
Final license/support scope, product name, accurate AI-use disclosure, and current publication-platform requirements require review. This audit is not legal advice or permission to publish.

detail.note: File presence does not establish valid Blender source, final license, or approved manifest. Internal generator sources are permitted only in review packages by the original design.

checks.detail: Requires fresh staging built only from release_manifest paths, hashes/sizes, no unlisted files, research, credentials, cache, or internal generator/recipe code.
Requires six named assembly examples, validation scene, neutral catalog scene, 84 approved-model PNG thumbnails, genuine engine images, and new-buyer import/reimport checks.
Requires the exact eight canonical IDs in design section 18, Moss only, own license and allowlist. No extra paid-only files.

detail.scope: Editable baked meshes, UV/materials and sockets; not parametric modifiers or art approval.

approval_policy: No automatic approvals; no publication performed.
scope: Local recorded-evidence audit. PASS for internal review is not sales readiness.
